host.cpu: AMD Ryzen AI 9 HX 470 class host; the /sys index3 domain 0-3 is the measured cell
host.pinning: taskset -c 0-3 for the measured process, RAYON_NUM_THREADS=4
host.observer: the shell that launched the runs stays on CPUs 60-63
host.load_average: 12-26 during the campaign (other jobs on the host), so the wall times are host-loaded; every cell alternates base and head and each side repeats bit for bit

state_construction.A: three branches x 20 binary sites, bond min(2^(i+1), 128), per-leg weight exp(-0.1 * bond index), canonicalized at the junction
state_construction.B1: A + transposed 20-site quantics Fourier operator on branch 0, ApplyOptions::zipup(), rtol 1e-8
state_construction.IFT: comb with bond cap 160 and weight exp(-0.2 * bond index), all three branches zip-up applied at rtol 1e-8

commands.campaign: run <kind> 1e-9 <label> <samples.bin>, two runs per side, base and head alternating
commands.reference: run <kind> 1e-15 (base), the state the accuracy column compares against
commands.bond dimensions: dims <kind> 1e-9, every bond dimension before and after, compared edge by edge

accuracy: relative L2 over 8192 uniformly sampled amplitudes written by `run` and compared offline
